policy_title: Enzyme Testing for Acute Pancreatitis Policy

sections.title: Application
sections.content: This reimbursement policy applies to all Medicare Advantage products and for network provider services reported using the UB04 and CMS 1500 form or its electronic equivalent or its successor form.

children.title: Overview
children.content: This policy describes the reimbursement methodology for services associated with pancreatic enzyme testing for acute pancreatitis when billed with designated conditions. Certain services are also subject to specific procedure code limitations.

children.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
children.content: NOTE: Procedure codes appearing in policy documents are included only as a general reference tool for each policy. They may not be all-inclusive.

children.title: Serum Lipase
children.content: UnitedHealthcare will consider reimbursement of the following serum lipase concentration procedure code for the initial determination of acute pancreatitis, no more than once per week, when billed for any of the conditions listed below: Procedure Code(s) 83690 Condition(s) a. Mild to severe epigastric pain that begins slowly or suddenly (may spread to the back in the same patients) b. Nausea c. Vomiting d. Tender to palpitation of epigastrium e. Abdominal distention f. Hypoactive bowel sounds g. Fever h. Rapid pulse i. Tachypnea j. Hypoxemia k. Hypotension l. Anorexia m. Diarrhea n. Cullen sign o. Grey Turner sign UnitedHealthcare will not consider reimbursement of the serum lipase procedure codes above for any other conditions.

children.title: Serum Amylase
content: UnitedHealthcare will not consider separate reimbursement of serum amylase when submitted in conjunction with lipase for the same date of service.

children.title: Urine Amylase
children.content: UnitedHealthcare will not consider reimbursement of urinary amylase concentration for the initial determination of acute pancreatitis for individuals presenting with signs and symptoms of acute pancreatitis. Procedure Code(s) 82150

children.title: Serum or Urine Trypsin/Trypsinogen/TAP
children.content: UnitedHealthcare will not consider reimbursement of serum or urine trypsin/trypsinogen/ TAP for the assessment, prognosis, and/or determination of acute pancreatitis. Procedure Code(s) 83519

children.title: Biomarker Testing
content: UnitedHealthcare will not consider reimbursement of the following biomarker procedure codes for the assessment, prognosis, and/or determination of acute pancreatitis.

content.value: Seven consecutive calendar days from the initial date of service, excluding the same date of service.

value.Q: Is the once per week limitation based on individual provider per member?
value.A: The once per week limitation is applicable across all billing and/or rendering providers (including any individual provider OR any facility) for each individual member.

value.Q: Is same date of service based on individual provider per member?
value.A: Same date of service is applicable across all billing and/or rendering providers (including any individual provider OR any facility) for each individual member.
